errors.evidence: The x-axis label in the figure is “短阵维度”, not “矩阵维度”.
The x-axis is not on a linear scale. The tick marks are evenly spaced, but the values they represent (64, 128, 256, 512, 768) are not at linear intervals.
The interval between x-axis ticks is not a uniform 64. The differences between consecutive tick values are 64, 128, 256, and 256.

errors.text_span: 继续上升至256时达到0.754，随后在512维度处保持0.754的峰值
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the line reaches 0.754 at dimension 256 and then maintains this value as the peak at dimension 512. In the plot, the line continues to rise from 0.754 at dimension 256 to a peak at dimension 512, which has a value visibly greater than 0.754 (approximately 0.755).
